sentences.text: To plot a bearing taken with the ship’s compass, first convert it to true, using the deviation for the boat’s heading, not for the bearing.
Steering zero eight zero by compass, with two degrees east deviation, you see a light bearing zero one five by compass.
Add east: zero one seven magnetic.
Subtract fourteen west: zero zero three true.
Now draw a line through the light in that direction.
Your boat lies somewhere along that line, on the side toward you, which runs from the light along the reciprocal, one eight three.
